canonical_edition: C. Hammer (ed., post L. Spengel), Rhetores Graeci, vol.1.2 (Teubner, 1894), pp.340–351.
sources_tested: Biblissima/Pinakes work record (identifies the title, Greek language, Hammer 1894 pp.340–351, and 15 manuscripts); Open Library and WorldCat 1894 edition records; Internet Archive metadata and page-image sampling for the 1894 Google scan; Wikimedia Commons/IA metadata and Greek page-image sampling for a 1856 Spengel alternate edition; local First1KGreek corpus/catalogue search, checked 2026-08-12.
open_text_result: No complete open Greek transcription corresponding to Minucianus Junior’s work was located in the installed licensed corpora. The nearby Rufus and Hermogenes witnesses must not be substituted for this distinct, independently transmitted tract.
open_text_license: No compatible open-text licence established for the complete work.
scan_result: A public-domain 1856 Spengel scan is a promising alternate edition, with explicit PDM/Commons public-domain metadata and visually sampled Greek pages, but the sampled pagination contains other rhetorical works and no exact Minucianus title/page-range mapping was established. The 1894 IA scan was inspected only as a candidate; its metadata states NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT but supplies no licence URL and the required pp.340–351 mapping was not demonstrated.
scan_rights: 1856 alternate: Commons marks the PDF Public domain; IA metadata uses PDM 1.0. This rights evidence is adequate only once the exact Minucianus pages are located. 1894 candidate: IA ‘possible-copyright-status=NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT’ but no image licence URL, so it is not transfer-ready under the strict rule.
next_action: Locate the title ‘Μινουκιανοῦ περὶ ἐπιχειρημάτων’ within the PDM 1856 volume by visual table-of-contents/page inspection, record its actual page/image sequence, visually sample a Greek page, then transfer that alternate edition with PDM provenance. Do not infer its pages from the Hammer 1894 citation.
notes: Biblissima records the exact work and manuscript tradition, but its Hammer pages cannot be assumed to match the scanned alternate editions. Temporary page samples were inspected and removed; no provider OCR was read or retained.
